name: @smithers-orchestrator/signal
description: The Smithers Signal — Cloudflare productionization of the daily-ceo-intel workflow: runner container, scheduler Worker, and the signal.smithers.sh magazine site.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p runner/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scheduler/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p site/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun test tests && pnpm --dir ../../.smithers run test:daily-ceo-intel
scripts.deploy:site: pnpm run site:build && alchemy deploy site/alchemy.run.ts
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:scheduler && pnpm run deploy:site
